facts.business: Arvind Fashions Limited is one of India's leading lifestyle companies with a portfolio of iconic global and homegrown brands spanning premium, mid-premium and youth fashion segments including U.S. Polo Assn., Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, Arrow and Flying Machine.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has pledged 4,63,51,265 equity shares of Arvind Lifestyle Brands Limited as a security against working capital loans availed by the Company and Arvind Lifestyle Brands Limited. The Company has pledged 4,05,75,090 equity shares of Arvind Youth Brands Retail Private Limited as a security against working capital loans availed by the Company.
